Dating LF3711-3712 reads: HABITA IN CONSISTORIO SECRETO DIE 13] 1VLU] ANNI NDCCCXLYUI. Date note: Edition dated caption Habita in consistorio ..., retained in the selection; it is the only printed dating of the speech.
